svg.title: Agentic ops loop
svg.text: An alert gets a diagnosis with evidence in minutes; anything that changes the platform needs a person
De-duplicate and rate-limit before any model
Pydantic AI agent with Claude Sonnet 4.6 on
Bedrock calls read-only MCP tools: metrics,
logs, pods, Kafka, Flink, Iceberg, Argo CD,
confidence, one action from a closed catalogue
Block Kit message; Approve is bound to that
Only ops-control has write RBAC; every step is
stored in Postgres; traces in Langfuse
RECORDED RUN EVIDENCE / NOT A LIVE STATUS CHECK
13 · read-only MCP tools, shared with the · Hermes on-call chat · 5 · catalogue actions (none, escalate, 3 · restarts or compaction) · 37 / 37 · guardrail
